title: What Is Fandango? Pricing & How It Works
summary: Learn what Fandango at Home is, how pricing works, and how to rent or buy movies and shows on the streaming platform.
body_markdown:
TL;DR


5


Quick Takeaways


What consumers and marketers need to know about Fandango.


1. 1


Fandango unifies free streaming, ticketing, rentals, and purchases.


2. 2


Its subscription-free model combines ad-supported viewing with premium options.


3. 3


A vast catalog and broad device support drive accessibility.


4. 4


Rapid audience and viewing growth strengthen its advertising value.


5. 5


The platform reflects CTV’s shift toward measurable performance marketing.
